permitted_use: Apartments and Mixed Use Residential development

standards.SUBPART A: 1 acre where common or public open space is dedicated; provided that extensions of 1 acre or less to an existing PMD from a common boundary may be considered
standards.SUBPART B: Multi-family: maximum of 145 units per acre
standards.SUBPART D: 45; measured from the lowest living area floor level & shall not exceed 45 from the highest elevation of the lot, or as approved by City Council where it can be demonstrated that the additional height will not have a detrimental effect on surrounding land uses
